1 كَرَدَ , (aor.
كَرُدَ , S, L,) inf. n. كَرْدٌ, He drove, (L, K,) drove away, and repelled, a people: (S, L:) accord. to some, he drove the enemy in a charge or assault: (L:) he drove away the enemy: (K:) he repelled them and drove them away with his sword. (L.) ―
-b2- He turned him back from his opinion. (L.) ＝
-A2- He cut off [a thing.] (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
